go_rule: A family is W3_GO_CANDIDATE iff IAS robust_high is true AND PIT feasibility is established under the frozen PIT-v2.1 protocol AND every F1-F9 gate is PASS.
w3_execution_rule: Even a W3_GO_CANDIDATE would authorize only separate W3 protocol drafting and byte-freeze, never immediate W3 execution.

global_decision.GO: At least one exact family satisfies go_rule.

interpretation_limits: NO_GO is a current evidence and reproducibility decision, not proof that information asymmetry is absent.
FEASIBILITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED is not FAIL and does not lower IAS.
NO_DECISIVE_HIGHEST_ASYMMETRY_LEADER does not prevent reporting robust-high families; it only blocks a singular strongest-family claim.
No W3 backtest or strategy execution occurs under this contract.
